implemented_change: Verify that each returned opening-tag position is a UTF-8 boundary, then check the actual streaming push_str caller with that contract and the existing tag-index guarantee.
caller_panic_effect: push_str is marked may_panic, matching its trait declaration and its allocation and generic Clone operations. Its modeled index and overflow obligations are still checked.

integration.cargo: Only the Flux macro package revisions changed.
integration.bazel: just bazel-lock-update and bazel mod deps --lockfile_mode=error passed.

mechanism.syntax: String-field is_char_boundary calls lower to the existing boundary model. A sealed Rust type witness validates standard String receivers and rejects custom lookalikes, including Deref wrappers.
mechanism.inference: The callback and iterator summaries infer the new position predicate from the existing function bodies.
mechanism.search_offset: str::find returns a byte boundary bounded by isize::MAX. Combining it with the delimiter length bound proves that the closing-match arithmetic fits usize.
mechanism.trusted_model_basis: A valid Rust str slice fits in isize::MAX bytes; Searcher returns valid byte boundaries. Standard-library extern specifications remain trusted models, using pinned Rust 8925ea358a0f265ca61026aadc7ecc506c545cbe.

mutation_meaning.invalid-position: Return usize::MAX as the opening position; the UTF-8 boundary postcondition fails.
mutation_meaning.invalid-index: Use self.specs.len() as the index inside push_str; the modeled vector precondition fails even though the caller permits panics.

validation.performance_note: The stronger UTF-8 position proof raises the uncached parser proof cost. Cached checks execute zero solver queries. Runs use warm Cargo artifacts; whole-project throughput has not been established.

proof_scope: The opening position and tag index contracts are verified, and push_str passes obligations generated by the currently observed models. This is a partial-correctness check with permitted panics, not a complete parser behavior or panic-freedom proof.
remaining_model_obligations: Model String indexing and drain with their UTF-8/range requirements and state effects.
Prove that matched delimiter ends and retained suffix splits are valid byte boundaries.
Relate the selected tag index to its delimiter value, then establish complete streaming interpretation and selection optimality.
Reduce the cost of inferred nested callback predicates.
